Reject a generic comprehensive-credit label when detailed financing types are disclosed.
Route regulatory authority, regulated subject, common subject_name and counterparty into non-overlapping roles.
Treat statutory appeal rights as neither reply_deadline, remedy_requirement nor uncertainty.
Recover one exact intellectual-property certificate-receipt stage and one exact buyback-cancellation date only under unique source anchors.
Reject selection of one project_name when multiple independent labelled bid projects are disclosed.
